audit_result.proof_trace: The `deleted_at` filter is applied in `getAllMembers` (members.ts:L18) and `syncAllRoles` (rolesSyncAll.ts:L19), but is absent in both `rolesSync.ts:syncRoles` (L25-29) and `nickname.ts:updateNickname` (L63-67). Both perform `SELECT * FROM members WHERE discord_uid = ?` without `.is('deleted_at', null)`, so soft-deleted members are returned and acted upon. In `syncRoles`, this causes Discord roles to be re-granted to a deleted member based on their still-valid DB record.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An operator (or internal service) calls `POST /api/roles/sync` with the `discord_uid` of a soft-deleted member; `syncRoles` fetches the deleted member from the DB (no `deleted_at` guard), then re-assigns all Discord roles (generation, team, leader, status, member, verified), effectively restoring the deleted member's Discord access.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-017.text: Soft-deleted members (deleted_at != null) must be excluded from all query results.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-017.assertion: forall query: results exclude members where deleted_at IS NOT NULL
